item: The launcher keeps the C library's abort message (free(): invalid pointer and its kind) beside the crash trace
summary: The server's stderr passes through an awk filter in launch.sh: every line still reaches the window; a line is recorded ONLY when it is exactly one of 41 fixed glibc 2.41 / interpreter abort messages (string equality, no pattern or tail; at most 20 per launch, file trimmed to 100 lines); every other line is counted and never stored, plus one summary per launch (dropped count) so 'filter ran' differs from 'no filter'. exit_evidence.launcher_stderr re-checks each line against the same list (a test pins the two equal), scrubs it, shows the newest 2 per session beside the trace (previous session and each earlier end; null = no launcher record) with the full count. Without awk the server starts as before. Worst case about 245 B per session. Open: musl/macOS libc messages, BSD awk untested, launch.cmd.
